scope:
Author second-government fixtures from the installed reference save (#194).

Derives two private saves from Original/Ph_Auto2.SAV into --out (never
committed): `monarchy.SAV` gives the human civ Monarchy and its prerequisite
closure while it stays in Despotism, and `anarchy.SAV` additionally puts it in
Anarchy. Only hashes, the patch description and native route vectors are
retained as evidence.

Native routines are executed on the derived saves exactly as in
rates_government_check.py: 0x525468 (eligibility, chooser list), 0x40966b (cap),
0x409704 (redistribution) and 0x5292d6 (anarchy resolution; 0x52588e recorded
and returns 0). The advance record table is not loaded by the harness, so the
enabled byte of the five government advances is set from the installed Rules.txt
(prerequisite 1 not nil). Live load of the derived saves in the original game
has NOT been exercised.

live_load.what: original-game load of the derived saves under the Wine oracle rig (tools/oracle/load_save.sh, Xvfb :99, ToTPP civ2.exe)

accepted_at_load.anarchy: loaded to the world twice: RAM turn 43, 38 units, 10 cities; world UI rendered (menu bar, fogged map, globe minimap)
accepted_at_load.monarchy: bytes identical to anarchy.SAV outside the civ block; same load path (not separately driven)
accepted_at_load.baseline_Ph_Auto2: loaded to the world and stayed alive 7+ minutes idle

not_observed: the turn-44 government chooser: in-world input did not land in this session (see regression below), so the on-screen chooser list is still unconfirmed in the live original
monarchy.SAV alone was not loaded interactively
results.divergence: both anarchy.SAV loads exited silently ~4-5 minutes after world entry (no Wine backtrace, civ2.log stops at the MIDI warnings); the pristine Ph_Auto2.SAV stayed alive. Reproduced twice; cause unknown
results.rig_regression: in-world input dead for every save including the pristine baseline: SendInput keys (winject), XTest keys (xtool) and X-level focus all produced no state change (turn 43, active unit 9, both RNG slots frozen); the game's world window is not enumerable by any external wine process (winject wins, 64- and 32-bit builds, list only Default IME) while dialog-phase windows were enumerable during the same run. Xvfb also died once mid-session and was restarted detached. Chooser observation deferred until the input path works again

live_load.retained: numeric/textual only; screenshots stayed outside the repository
live_load.install_state: autosave slots Ph_Auto/Ph_Auto2/Ca_Auto2 restored and sha256-verified after the runs; fixture saves removed from Original/
